answer: Mark Rutte is the Secretary General of NATO, and yes, he is in his first term. Rutte took office on October 1, 2024, replacing Jens Stoltenberg who served for 10 years (2014-2024). Rutte's term as Secretary General began in 2024.
sources: Knowledge of NATO leadership changes from training data through February 2025
